'''Stage VI Bio-Desolator Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model developed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. These bipedal [[Droid/Legends|droids]] armed with a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] were guarding the [[Shadow Arsenal]] on [[Quesh]].
